title: One of an agent's own jobs, step by step: the answer of jobs/status (E151)
description: A job is a plan whose operation is jobs/run: up to eight steps in order under one approval, a later step naming an earlier answer by its JSON pointer. `state` is the plan's while no step has run (pending, declined, expired) and the job's afterwards; `step` is the step a running, waiting, released or failed job stands at (1 before the first). `word` says why a job was released or failed. Each step shows its operation, whether it is pending, reserved or completed, and the SHA-256 of its stored answer; no answer is shown. A read computes expiry and never writes it. A waiting job also shows the question its step asks, the offered choices and the `choice_token` its person answers with (`jobs/answer`). `review_url` is the page where the job's person reviews the proposal.
